title: Place Value
shortDescription: Practise identifying place value by drawing a line to match each number to its place value.
intro: Look at the red digit in each number. Drag from its dot to the dot next to the matching place value to draw a line.
seoDescription: Free interactive Grade 6 Maths worksheet on place value. Draw lines to match the red digit in each number to its place value and get an instant score.

questions.prompt: Join each number to the place value of its red digit.
